card.name: Words leading up to injection route
card.fires_on: Small words just before an injection term in drug labels, such as "by" before "subcutaneous injection" or "next" before "injection". Also fires inside the name depo-subQ provera 104.

modes.label: Before injection
modes.description: Linking word like by, next or last right before the word injection or subcutaneous.
modes.example: Administer HUMALOG ® U-100 or U-200<< by>> subcutaneous injection into the abdominal wall

modes.label: Inside depo-subQ provera
modes.description: Pieces of the brand name depo-subQ provera 104.

modes.label: Section number digit
modes.description: A digit in a cross-reference to warnings sections.

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word away from written or oral wording, which fits an expected injection route.
card.plain: It lights up on small words right before a mention of an injection, such as by subcutaneous injection.
